# Camera moves & transitions

36 names · #3 001~024 · 049~056 · 064~067 · pack `camera` · Languages: [日本語](README.ja.md) / [简体中文](README.zh-Hans.md)

Find the name, then say it to your AI. Add how long, how strong and what moves, and the result gets closer to what you had in mind.

## Camera Movement

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-001](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-001) | **Pan** | Pivot the camera left or right | Slow pan from left to right across the skyline, camera fixed in place, over 5 seconds. |
| [#3-002](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-002) | **Tilt** | Pivot the camera up or down | Slow tilt up from the person's feet to the top of the tower. |
| [#3-003](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-003) | **Dolly in** | Move the camera toward the subject | Slow dolly in toward her face; move the camera, do not zoom. |
| [#3-004](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-004) | **Zoom in** | Magnify with the lens (camera stays put) | The camera stays still; zoom in on the person at the window over 3 seconds. |
| [#3-005](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-005) | **Tracking shot** | Move along with the subject | Tracking shot from the side, moving along with the walking person at the same speed. |
| [#3-006](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-006) | **Orbit (Arc shot)** | Circle around the subject | Half orbit around the standing person, keeping them in the center of the frame. |
| [#3-007](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-007) | **Crane up** | Lift the camera up | Crane up from eye level until the whole town comes into view. |
| [#3-008](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-008) | **Dolly zoom (Vertigo)** | Subject stays, background warps | Dolly zoom on his face at the moment he realizes: he stays the same size while the background stretches away. |

## Shooting Style & Time

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-009](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-009) | **Rack focus** | Shift focus between near and far | Rack focus from the cup in the foreground to the person behind it, in 1 second. |
| [#3-010](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-010) | **Handheld** | A slight shake, as if the camera were held by hand | Handheld shot following behind the walking person, with only a slight shake. |
| [#3-011](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-011) | **FPV drone shot** | Fast, immersive fly-through | FPV drone shot weaving between the trees and out over the river. |
| [#3-012](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-012) | **Dutch angle** | Tilt the frame diagonally | Use a Dutch angle of about 15 degrees for this uneasy scene. |
| [#3-013](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-013) | **Slow motion** | Play the action slower | Show the moment of the splash in slow motion. |
| [#3-014](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-014) | **Speed ramp** | Change speed mid-shot | Speed ramp: normal speed, slowing at the top of the jump, then back to normal. |
| [#3-015](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-015) | **Time-lapse** | Compress hours into seconds | Time-lapse of the city from dusk to night as the lights come on. |
| [#3-016](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-016) | **Freeze frame** | Pause the action for a beat | Freeze frame at the moment she turns around; hold for 1 second and show her name. |

## Transitions

| # | Name | What it is | How to ask an AI |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-017](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-017) | **Jump cut** | Same framing, skip ahead in time | Use jump cuts from the same framing to move quickly through the preparation. |
| [#3-018](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-018) | **Match cut** | Cut on a matching shape or motion | Match cut from the round coffee cup to a full moon in the same position. |
| [#3-019](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-019) | **Whip pan** | Fast pan blur into the next shot | Whip pan to the right and land in the next location. |
| [#3-020](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-020) | **Cross dissolve** | Blend one shot into the next | Cross dissolve from the room in the morning to the same room at night, 1 second. |
| [#3-021](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-021) | **Wipe** | A moving edge replaces the shot | Wipe from left to right into the next scene. |
| [#3-022](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-022) | **Smash cut** | Abrupt cut to a contrasting scene | Smash cut from the quiet bedroom to a noisy intersection. |
| [#3-023](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-023) | **J-cut** | Next scene's audio starts first | J-cut: let the sound of waves from the next scene start before cutting to the sea. |
| [#3-024](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-024) | **L-cut** | Previous scene's audio carries over | L-cut: keep her voice going while cutting to the listener's face. |
| [#3-064](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-064) | **Establishing shot** | A wide shot that sets up the place and who stands where, before cutting closer | Open with a 2-second establishing shot of two people sitting opposite each other in a café, then cut to a close shot of one of them. |
| [#3-065](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-065) | **Shot/reverse shot** | Cutting back and forth between two over-the-shoulder angles of a conversation | Shoot the two-person dialogue as shot/reverse shot, cutting between over-the-shoulder angles every 1.5 seconds, the speaker always facing the camera. |
| [#3-066](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-066) | **Match on action** | Cut mid-movement so the action carries on in the next shot | Use a match on action as he pushes open a door: cut to the inside angle halfway through, and the door keeps opening in the next shot. |
| [#3-067](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-067) | **180-degree rule** | Keep every camera on one side of the line between two people so left and right never flip | Follow the 180-degree rule for the two-person dialogue: every camera on the same side, the heroine always on the left of the frame. |

|---|---|---|---|
| [#3-049](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-049) | **Extreme long shot** | The person is tiny; the frame is mostly about the place | Extreme long shot of him walking alone through a valley, the figure about a tenth of the frame height, for 4 seconds. |

| [#3-052](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-052) | **Medium shot** | Framed from the waist up, so hand gestures read clearly | Medium shot of her raising her right hand to wave, the bottom edge of the frame at the waist, for 3 seconds. |
| [#3-053](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-053) | **Medium close-up** | Framed from the chest up, centred on speech and expression | Medium close-up of her speaking, the bottom edge of the frame at her chest, for 3 seconds. |
| [#3-054](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-054) | **Close-up** | Head and shoulders fill the frame, so small expressions lead | Close-up of him hearing a sound, his eyes flicking and blinking once, framed down to the shoulders, for 3 seconds. |

| [#3-056](https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/#3-056) | **Macro shot** | A very small subject shot so it fills the frame | Macro shot of a small mushroom, the focus slowly pulling sharp until a tiny bug crawling over the cap is visible, for 4 seconds. |
